== Summary ==
Slip “•Dark Collaboration” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF file created 17 June 2023; [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf preserved copy]), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 490, 1624, 775)). Version [[Dark Collaboration (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
